1.w: The burden of the wilderness the Sea: Like whirlwinds in the Negev passing through, it comes from the wilderness, from a fearsome land.

2.w: A harsh vision is declared to me: “The treacherous one deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, O Elam! Besiege, O Media! All her sighing I have made cease.”

3.w: Upon thus my loins are filled [with] pain; pangs have taken hold of me like the pangs of one giving birth. I am writhing from hearing; I am disturbed from seeing.

4.w: My heart staggers, a shuddering terrifies me; the twilight of my desire has been set for me into fear,

5.w: to arrange the table [and] lay out the spread, to eat, to drink. Rise up, O princes, [and] anoint the shield!

6.w: For thus the Lord has said to me: “Go, station the one keeping watch and let him declare what he sees.

7.w: And he sees a chariot [with] a pair of horses, the rider of a donkey, [and] the rider of a camel, and he will be attentive, [with] great attention.”

8.w: And the lookout called out: “Upon the watchtower, my Lord, I stand continually by day, and at my post I take [my] stand every night.

9.w: And behold this, the chariot of a man is coming, [with] a pair of horses.” And he answered and said, “Fallen, Babylon has fallen! And all the images of her gods He has broken to the ground!”

10.w: O my threshing, and the son of my threshing floor, that which I have heard from YHWH of Hosts, the God of Israel, I have declared to you⁺!

11.w: The burden of Dumah: To me one is calling from Seir: “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

12.w: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you⁺ would inquire, [then] inquire; return, come.”

13.w: The burden upon Arabia: In the thicket you⁺ lodge in Arabia, O caravans of Dedanites,

14.w: to meet the thirsty one. Bring water, O dwellers of the land of Tema, with his bread meet the one fleeing.

15.w: For they do flee from the face of swords, from the sword drawn, and from the bow bent, and from the weight of war.

16.w: For thus says the Lord to me: “Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, then will end all the glory of Kedar.

17.w: And the remnant of the number of archers, the mighty ones of the sons of Kedar, will be few.” For YHWH, the God of Israel, has spoken.
